name: codekeeper-acceptance
description: Offline-tested acceptance harness for an explicitly supplied private Codekeeper fixture

scripts.check: bash -c 'for file in bin/*.mjs src/*.mjs test/*.mjs audit/*.mjs fixture/src/*.mjs fixture/test/*.mjs; do node --check "$file"; done' && node --test test/*.test.mjs audit/*.test.mjs && node --test fixture/test/*.test.mjs
